text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To begin my assessment, have you noticed any changes in your urination, such as increased frequency, urgency, or blood in your urine?

text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fever and flank pain persisting after your sinusitis treatment is concerning. Has the pain radiated to your groin, and have you noticed any nausea, vomiting, or shaking chills recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
